{{Top}}
'''Foamcast''' was a type of material used to make buildings.<ref name="BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some of the buildings and their roofs built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|rimsoos]] were made from foamcast.<ref name="BS" />
